title: Same Signal, Opposite Meaning: Direction-Informed Adaptive Learning for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.06908v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Adaptive test-time compute for LLM agents aims to invoke extra computation only when it improves performance. Existing methods typically use confidence-, uncertainty-, or difficulty-based gates, assuming a fixed direction from the gating signal through compute need to the value of computation. This makes gating a utility-calibration problem: gating signals should align with whether extra computation improves the final outcome over the base policy. We show that this alignment is unstable: the same signal predicts rollout benefit in one setting and rollout harm in another, with reversals across environments and backbones even when the task is fixed. Wrong-direction gates can therefore worsen performance by precisely selecting harmful states. translated_title: 相同信号，相反含义：面向LLM智能体的方向感知自适应学习
translated_abstract: LLM智能体的自适应测试时计算旨在仅在额外计算能提升性能时才调用它。现有方法通常采用基于置信度、不确定性或难度的门控机制，并假设从门控信号经计算需求到计算价值的方向是固定的。这使得门控成为一个效用校准问题：门控信号应当与额外计算能否比基础策略改善最终结果保持一致。我们证明这种对齐是不稳定的：同一个信号在一种设置下预示rollout会带来收益，在另一种设置下却预示rollout会造成损害，即使任务固定，这种反转也会跨环境和跨骨干模型出现。因此，方向错误的门控可能恰恰通过选中有害状态而使性能恶化。这种反转反映了计算需求与计算适宜性之间更深层的区别：高不确定性信号可能指示决策困难的状态，此时rollout有助于比较备选方案……
tldr: 本文揭示了LLM智能体自适应计算中门控信号的方向不稳定性——同一信号在不同环境和模型下可能预示额外计算的收益或损害，并据此提出方向感知的自适应学习方法，以区分计算需求与计算适宜性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the unstable directionality of gating signals in adaptive test-time compute for LLM agents—the same signal can predict either benefit or harm from extra computation across settings—and proposes direction-informed adaptive learning to distinguish compute need from compute suitability.
